name: Edge-Centric Capacity Formulation
description: We replace the explicit vertex-centric exclusion ("no two active modules can be linked") with an edge-centric capacity constraint ("every conduit is linked to at most one active module"). This preserves the exact independent set semantics without using the standard "no adjacent vertices" phrasing, forcing models to deduce the structural requirement from the conduit capacities while completely avoiding the task drift of dual (vertex cover) formulations.
